title: SimWorld world profile
description: SimWorld world profile: every tuning value of the streamed world. All keys are optional in a file or in `profile_overrides` (omitted keys keep the defaults; objects merge deeply, arrays and scalars replace). Structural values (4 bands over zooms 13-16, layer names) are not tunable. Defaults = addons/simworld/profiles/default.json = the compiled-in defaults.

profile_version.description: Profile schema version (integer). A file with the library's version or older is strict (an unknown key is an error); a newer file loads and unknown keys are ignored with a warning. The library reads version 6 (version 2 added buildings.r0..r2.min_height_m, version 3 added lights.min_ring, version 4 added the landmark and dark light profiles, lights.profiles.*.windows / floodlight, buildings.overrides, dark_states, slender_tower, min_window_wall_m, lights.street and lights.beacons, version 5 added the terrain section, version 6 added the seed section; an older file loads with their defaults).

bands.description: LOD bands as a quadtree cover by 3D slant distance (camera to the nearest point of a tile's box). R0 = z16 ... R3 = z13.

r0_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R0 (z16, full extrusion), meters. Must be below r1_edge_m.

r1_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R1 (z15), meters. Must be below r2_edge_m.

r2_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R2 (z14), meters. Must be below r3_edge_m.

r3_edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of R3 (z13, light points only) and of the whole cover, meters. Nothing is requested beyond it (times hysteresis for tiles already in).

hysteresis.description: Factor: a tile changes band only once its slant distance is this far past the band edge (1.15 = 15 %). The gap edge x (hysteresis - 1) also drives the dithered LOD fade.

look_ahead_s.description: Look-ahead horizon, seconds: each band's view point is camera + velocity x this (vertical speed included).

look_ahead_clamp.description: Look-ahead offset clamp as a fraction of the band's edge (0.5 = half the band radius).

default_tile_height_m.description: Box height (meters) assumed for a tile whose own and ancestors' building heights are not known yet.

buildings.description: Building meshing per band (R3 has no buildings) and the light-profile resolution rules (profile_version 4; docs/spec-night-windows.md section 1).

r0.description: Building meshing at R0 (z16, nearest band).

min_area_m2.description: Drop buildings whose footprint is smaller, square meters (0 = keep all).

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

min_area_m2.description: Drop buildings whose footprint is smaller, square meters (0 = keep all).

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

min_area_m2.description: Drop buildings whose footprint is smaller, square meters (0 = keep all).

min_height_m.description: Drop buildings whose resolved roof height is lower, meters above ground (tagged height, else levels x floor height, else the kind/landuse fallback; per feature, like min_area_m2; 0 = keep all; profile_version 2). Building mesh only: lights, ground and roads are unaffected.

overrides.description: Light profile by OSM id, first rule of the resolution (wins over state tags, kind tables and the shape heuristic). Keys: `n`, `w` or `r` followed by the OSM id (e.g. `w123456`); values: a light profile name. For hand-picked places where tagging or shape fails. Default: none (profile_version 4).

additionalProperties.description: Light profile of this OSM element.

dark_states.description: State tags that make a building `dark` (no windows, no light point) whatever its kind: `key` (attribute present; for the flags: yes) or `key=value`, over the tile attributes historic, man_made, ruins, disused, abandoned (profile_version 4).

slender_tower.description: Shape heuristic for buildings of a generic kind (in no profile's kinds, nor their historic / man_made values) with a tagged height or levels and a footprint the tile encoder did not clip: height >= ratio x sqrt(area) and area < max_area_m2 makes it a landmark (profile_version 4).

ratio.description: Minimum roof height over the square root of the footprint area.

max_area_m2.description: Footprints at least this large (square meters) are never towers.

min_window_wall_m.description: Wall parts lower than this (meters, extrusion height = height - min_height) get no windows (profile_version 4).

ground.description: Ground meshing (landuse areas and road strips) per band, road classes and widths, area classes and stacking levels. R3 has a coarse ground since api 1.3.

r0.description: Ground meshing at R0 (z16, nearest band).

area_dp_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for area outlines, meters.

min_area_m2.description: Drop areas smaller than this, square meters (0 = keep all).

road_dp_m.description: Douglas-Peucker tolerance for road centerlines, meters.

max_road_class.description: Keep roads of this class and every more important one (other = all roads).

lift_step_m.description: Vertical lift per stacking level, meters (against z-fighting; level up to 13 for roads).

r3.description: Ground meshing at R3 (z13, farthest band; api 1.3): a coarse ground so a far tile is never see-through while its R2 children load. The archive has major roads only at z13.

roads.description: Road classes (contract ground COLOR b = class / 8: 1 motorway, 2 primary, 3 secondary, 4 tertiary, 5 residential, 6 other) and full strip widths.

other_width_m.description: Full strip width (meters) of class 6: every highway value not listed in another class (service, pedestrian, footway, path, ...).

link_width_factor.description: `_link` roads keep their class at this fraction of its width, rounded to 0.1 m.

link_min_width_m.description: Minimum full width (meters) of a `_link` road.

minor_paths.description: Class-6 highway values that count as minor paths: kept at R0 only (ground.r1/r2 minor_paths = false drops them).

lit_values.description: OSM `lit` values (trimmed) that mark a road as lit (ground COLOR g = 1).

areas.description: Area groups by free name: each maps `landuse` layer kinds to a ground class and a stacking level. Add a group to classify more kinds; a kind may appear in one group only.

class.description: Ground class (contract ground COLOR r = id / 16): grass 0, forest 1, water 2, residential 3, commercial 4, industrial 5, other 6.

level.description: Stacking level against z-fighting, 0..7 (higher draws on top; roads use 8..13). Lift = level x the band's lift_step_m.

other_area_level.description: Stacking level of landuse kinds listed in no group (class other).

lights.description: Light sprites (bands min_ring..R3, default R2/R3) and building light profiles.

cluster_on_agl_m.description: Above this height above ground (meters) each tile's lights are clustered into cells (the light carpet); already delivered lit tiles are re-delivered.

cluster_off_agl_m.description: Below this height above ground (meters) clustering switches off again (hysteresis). Must not exceed cluster_on_agl_m.

cluster_cell_m.description: Cell size (meters) of the clustered light carpet.

min_ring.description: Finest band that carries light sprites (0 = R0 ... 3 = R3 only; profile_version 3). Default 1 (profile_version 4; 2 before): R1 to R3. R0 has windows only; R1 has windows up close and the host cross-fades windows and sprites over its blend range (docs/spec-night-windows.md W4). 2 = R2 and R3 only (R1 windows fade to nothing, no sprites there); 0 also puts sprites on R0.

street.description: Street lamps along roads: their own sprite set (ready-tile keys street_lights / street_light_colors, api 1.1), drawn near and far (no window cross-fade).

min_ring.description: Finest band with street lamps (0 = R0 ... 3 = R3 only, 4 = none). R3 (z13) tiles hold major roads only, so R3 lamps line motorways to secondaries.

color.description: Street lamp sprite color, linear rgb 0..1 (sodium orange by default).

alt_color.description: Second lamp type, linear rgb 0..1 (white LED by default), used on alt_share of the roads.

alt_share.description: Share of lit roads (0..1) whose lamps are alt_color, chosen per road by its OSM id (a street keeps one lamp type in every tile and band). 0 = every road in color.

spacing_m.description: Distance between lamps along a road centerline (meters).

untagged_max_class.description: Roads of this class or a more important one (1 motorway, 2 primary, 3 secondary, 4 tertiary, 5 residential, 6 other) get lamps without a lit tag; a road with a lit tag always does. 0 = tagged roads only.

beacons.description: Aircraft warning beacons on tall buildings, placed from geometry alone (resolved roof height and footprint, never tags), so synthesised cities get them by the same rule. Ready-tile keys beacon_lights / beacon_light_colors (api 1.2; a = blink phase).

min_ring.description: Finest band with beacons (0 = R0 ... 3 = R3 only, 4 = none).

min_height_m.description: Buildings whose resolved roof height (meters above their base) reaches this get beacons on the roof corners.

level_spacing_m.description: Taller buildings also get a ring of beacons every this many meters up the facade, while at least half a spacing below the roof. 0 = roof only.

corner_min_size_m.description: Footprints narrower than this (meters, along either axis) get one beacon in the middle of the roof instead of the corners.

color.description: Beacon color, linear rgb 0..1 (red by default).

alt_color.description: Second beacon color, linear rgb 0..1 (green by default), used on alt_share of the beacon buildings.

alt_share.description: Share of beacon buildings (0..1) in alt_color, chosen per building by its OSM id.

profiles.description: Light profiles (contract vertex COLOR r = id / 8: residential 0, office 1, retail 2, industrial 3, civic 4, landmark 6, dark 7; 5 is reserved): which OSM building, historic and man_made values belong to each, the sprite color, and the window / floodlight parameters. A value may appear in one profile only (profile_version 4 adds landmark and dark).

residential.description: Light profile residential (id 0): warm 2700 K, windows.

kinds.description: OSM `building`, `historic` and `man_made` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

windows.description: Lit windows (residential, office, retail and civic only; no key = no windows).

width_m.description: Target window column width, meters (the mesher fits a whole number of columns per wall run).

lit_share.description: Share of lit windows per local hour 0..23 (24 values, 0..1; read by the host shader). Between 18 h and 3 h it should only fall (a rise is logged as a warning).

office.description: Light profile office (id 1): cool 4500 K, windows.

kinds.description: OSM `building`, `historic` and `man_made` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

width_m.description: Target window column width, meters (the mesher fits a whole number of columns per wall run).

lit_share.description: Share of lit windows per local hour 0..23 (24 values, 0..1; read by the host shader). Between 18 h and 3 h it should only fall (a rise is logged as a warning).

retail.description: Light profile retail (id 2): bright white, windows.

kinds.description: OSM `building`, `historic` and `man_made` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

lit_share.description: Share of lit windows per local hour 0..23 (24 values, 0..1; read by the host shader). Between 18 h and 3 h it should only fall (a rise is logged as a warning).

industrial.description: Light profile industrial (id 3): sodium, no windows.

lit_share.description: Share of lit windows per local hour 0..23 (24 values, 0..1; read by the host shader). Between 18 h and 3 h it should only fall (a rise is logged as a warning).

landmark.description: Light profile landmark (id 6): castles, towers, churches; no windows, floodlit facade, light points in its color.

kinds.description: OSM `building`, `historic` and `man_made` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

floodlight.description: Floodlit facade (landmark only, required there; read by the host shader).

strength.description: Emission multiplier at the base of the facade.

fade_height_m.description: Height above the wall bottom (meters) over which the floodlight fades out.

dark.description: Light profile dark (id 7): ruins, garages, chimneys; no windows and no light point (its color is unused).

kinds.description: OSM `building`, `historic` and `man_made` values of this profile (a value may appear in one profile only).

landuse_fallback.description: Profile of buildings whose kind is in no profile, by the landuse polygon around them.

industrial.description: Profile for landuse industrial (and railway, port, depot, garages, quarry).

civic.description: Profile for landuse religious, education, institutional, civic, military.

none.description: Profile when no landuse polygon contains the building.

max_fetch_per_band.description: Tile fetches in flight per band (count).

max_mesh_per_band.description: Decode and mesh jobs in flight per band (count).

redeliveries_per_frame.description: Light-mode re-deliveries handed out per frame (count).

retry_base_s.description: Retry backoff after a failed fetch or decode: first wait, seconds; doubled per attempt (at most 64x).

retry_max_s.description: Retry backoff cap, seconds. Must not be below retry_base_s.

cap_s.description: Safety cap, seconds: a LOD fade is force-completed this long after it started (default 0.75; also bounds how long a stationary camera waits for a frozen fade before the next finer ring may refine).

max_active.description: Most LOD swaps (a coarse tile and its 4 children) fading at once, vector and terrain layer together (count; default 4, profile_version 6). The dithered variant discards pixels, which turns off hidden surface removal on tile-based GPUs (Apple); a swap beyond the cap completes at once without a fade. 0 = no fades.

recenter_distance_m.description: Re-center the floating origin when the camera is farther than this (meters, horizontal) from it.

cap_mb.description: Disk cache LRU cap, MiB (raw tile bytes; meshes are never cached).

open_retry_s.description: Minimum wait (seconds) before re-opening an archive that failed to open.

validate_retry_s.description: While the archive is unreachable, re-validate the disk cache against it this often (seconds).

terrain.description: Procedural terrain (profile_version 5, docs/spec-terrain.md): heights from a seeded function (fractal hills, ridged mountain chains, plateaus, valleys, a sea level and a flat zone around the configure origin), no data. Active only when terrain.enabled is true AND the host passes configure_world option layers containing "terrain"; otherwise the world stays flat (a warning is logged once when only enabled is set). bands, skirt_m, shading, horizon_*, max_fetch and max_mesh drive the terrain-mesh layer (api 1.5: terrain tiles with keys t/z/x/y for that host).

enabled.description: Terrain on (needs the host layer "terrain" too).

seed.description: Seed of the height function: same seed, same world.

amplitude_m.description: Relief scale, meters: heights are about amplitude_m x (0.5 + s), with the shape value s mostly in [-1, 1] (ridges reach above).

feature_size_m.description: Size of the largest hills (first noise octave), meters.

octaves.description: Noise octaves (each half the size of the previous).

ridge_share.description: Strength of ridged mountain chains (inside a low-frequency mountain mask), 0..1.

valley_share.description: Depth of the meandering valleys, 0..1 (1 = down to the valley floor below sea level, i.e. flat river plains).

plateau_share.description: Share of the land raised into flat-topped plateaus with escarpments, 0..1.

sea_level_m.description: Nothing is lower than this (flat sea, lakes, river plains), meters above MSL.

flat_radius_m.description: Radius of the flat zone around the configure origin, meters (re-centering does not move it). 0 with flat_blend_m 0 = no flat zone.

flat_blend_m.description: Width of the smooth blend from the flat zone into the relief, meters.

exaggeration.description: Vertical scale of every height (terrain, building bases, lights, ground_height_at).

water_snap_m.description: Water-area vertices take the minimum terrain height within this radius (5 x 5 window) and water is not subdivided, meters; 0 (default) = water drapes like every other area. Only for terrain with flat lakes of its own (a DEM).

drape_step_m.description: Ground area and road edges longer than this are subdivided where the terrain is not flat within 0.1 m along them, meters.

detail_scale_max.description: Upper bound of the runtime terrain detail scale (terrain-mesh phase); sizes the drape lift: lift(band) = largest max_error_m x detail_scale_max of the terrain bands within that band's reach.

skirt_m.description: Skirt depth of terrain tiles, meters; 0 = automatic (terrain-mesh phase).

shading.description: Terrain mesh shading (terrain-mesh phase): flat (normals from screen derivatives) or smooth (NORMAL array).

horizon_cull.description: Drop terrain tiles below the horizon of a real-size Earth (terrain-mesh phase).

horizon_margin_m.description: Extra distance past the horizon before a terrain tile is culled, meters (terrain-mesh phase).

max_fetch.description: Terrain jobs waiting for their samples per band (terrain-mesh phase).

max_mesh.description: Terrain mesh jobs in flight per band (terrain-mesh phase).

near_zoom.description: Finest zoom of the terrain layer (ring 0). Must not be below far_zoom.

far_zoom.description: Coarsest zoom of the terrain layer (the roots).

bands.description: One entry per terrain zoom, near_zoom first (exactly near_zoom - far_zoom + 1 entries; edges strictly increasing). The array replaces the default as a whole.

items.description: One terrain band (ring i = zoom near_zoom - i).

edge_m.description: Outer slant-distance edge of the band, meters; strictly increasing over the array.

max_error_m.description: Max vertical error of the terrain mesh in this band, meters (the low-poly knob; terrain-mesh phase). Also sizes the drape lift of the vector world (lift rule).

max_edge_m.description: Seed grid spacing so the visual earth curvature bends flat tiles, meters; 0 = corners only, else at least 500 (terrain-mesh phase).

max_triangles.description: Hard triangle cap per terrain tile (terrain-mesh phase).

seed.description: World seed (profile_version 6, docs/spec-world-seed.md section 9.2): how a seed world's generated airports, countryside and terrain-water rule look. Used only by a world configured with the configure_world option seed_world (api 1.7). Phase S1 keys; later phases add city, styles, roads and landmarks.

aeroway_class.description: Ground class written for airport fences and pavements: 7 (aeroway, api 1.7, COLOR b = sub-kind / 8: 0 field, 1 runway paved, 2 runway grass, 3 taxiway, 4 apron) or 6 (other; for a host without the class 7 shader branch, which then shows class 7 in its unknown-class colour).

water.description: The terrain-water rule (spec section 5.2a): the sea is flat at terrain.sea_level_m, lakes at their level, land slopes down to the water. Rivers are not part of the rule (vector water only).

blend_m.description: Land within this distance of the sea or a lake slopes down to the water level, meters.

raster_n.description: Signed-distance raster samples per side of a z11 cell (64 desktop, 32 for a quarter of the memory, e.g. iOS).

airport.description: Generated airports (spec section 5.1): runways from the airport file, strips, taxiways, apron, terminal, hangars, tower, fence and lights.

shoulder_m.description: The flat airport ground blends into the surrounding terrain over this distance outside the fence, meters.

strip_end_m.description: The runway strip extends this far past each physical runway end, meters.

strip_half_m.description: Half-width of the runway strip (no buildings or streets; level in the terrain), meters, by airport type.

small.description: Value for small_airport (and every other type).

fence_margin_m.description: The fence is the rectangle around every strip, pavement and building plus this margin, meters.

taxi_offset_m.description: Parallel taxiway centreline distance from the main runway centreline, meters, by airport type (0 or too close = no parallel taxiway; small fields never get one).

small.description: Value for small_airport (and every other type).

taxiway_width_m.description: Taxiway width, meters, by airport type.

small.description: Value for small_airport (and every other type).

runway_width_m.description: Runway width when the airport file has none, meters, by airport type.

small.description: Value for small_airport (and every other type).

default_length_m.description: Length of a runway whose file entry has neither ends nor length_ft, meters.

max_slope.description: Steepest runway in the terrain (rise over run, 0.01 = 1 %): threshold heights of the relief further apart than this are moved toward their mean, so the procedural hills never give a runway a ski-jump slope.

lights.description: Airport lights (ready-tile keys airport_lights / airport_light_colors, api 1.7) for runways marked lighted in the airport file. Never clustered.

height_m.description: Height of a light above the drawn pavement, meters.

edge_spacing_m.description: Runway edge lights every this many meters on both edges (white).

approach_length_m.description: Length of the approach light row before each threshold, meters (0 = none).

approach_spacing_m.description: Spacing of the approach lights along the row, meters.

approach_min_runway_m.description: Only paved runways at least this long get approach lights, meters.

taxiway_spacing_m.description: Taxiway edge lights every this many meters (medium and large airports, blue).

intensity.description: COLOR a of every airport light (intensity weight, like the other light keys).

edge_color.description: Runway edge light colour, linear rgb 0..1 (white).

end_color.description: Runway end light colour, linear rgb 0..1 (red).

taxiway_color.description: Taxiway edge light colour, linear rgb 0..1 (blue).

countryside.description: Countryside ground (spec section 5.2): forest / farmland / meadow patches on the z15 grid with warped edges, plus a tint per patch (ground COLOR g = tint / 8).

forest_share.description: Approximate share of the land that is forest.

water_forest_share.description: Forest share for patches within water_distance_m of water.

meadow_share.description: Share of the non-forest patches that are meadow (the rest is farmland; both resolve to the grass class, the tint tells them apart).

noise_cells.description: Size of the low-frequency noise that groups forests, in z15 cells (about 700 m each).

tint_levels.description: Number of tint values (COLOR g = tint / 8, tint 0..levels-1).

edge_warp.description: Patch corners and edge points move up to this share of a z15 cell, so fields are not squares.
